query:
SELECT
            t.id "id!: i32",
            t.game_id "game_id: i32",
            t.turn_number "turn_number: i32",
            t.file_id "file_id: i32",
            t.created_at "created_at: DateTime<Utc>",
            t.archived,
            t.turnkey "turnkey: i32",
            t.winner "winner: i32"
        FROM turns t
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT game_id, MAX(turn_number) as max_turn
            FROM turns
            WHERE archived=false AND game_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each($1))
            GROUP BY game_id
        ) latest ON t.game_id = latest.game_id AND t.turn_number = latest.max_turn
        WHERE t.archived=false
